red_first.description: New tests ran before implementation and failed for the expected reason.
canaries: legacy oracle: SEVERITY_RANK swap -> 3 failures, restored -> green
VC03 route reasons disabled -> 10 failures, restored -> green
validate_pdf_output with foreign headline -> FAIL lever headline missing
proposed baseline override activated in scratch copy -> PASS; one further byte in client_story.py -> FAIL invalid_override

findings.summary: Plan and model chose levers independently; with a priority context the plan ignored weights and render_diagnosis_pdf could render other levers than the model.
findings.fix: Both builders receive identical priority args; model fails closed when plan.top_levers differ.

findings.summary: preferred_order sorted category weight before confidence, so a profile could overtake a higher-confidence finding.
findings.fix: Key (severity, -confidence, -weight, role, id): profiles only order genuine ties.

findings.summary: VC03 had no customer route; a VC03 finding could borrow a core metric_ref and pass the CORE_METRIC route.
findings.fix: VC03_DIAGNOSTIC route; VC03 evidence forces that route and forbids metric_refs.

findings.summary: Protected baseline reports invalid_override for client_story, build_client_report_model, build_visualization_plan, build_audit_deliverables.
findings.fix: Hash-bound proposal reports/branch-priority-vc03-shared-overrides.PROPOSED.json; activation needs human authorization of a new ALLOWED_REASON_PATHS reason.

findings.summary: vibecheck03 parser ignored link/meta outside an explicit <head>; plural ui_scenarios key silently dropped.
validated_roles raised even when no profile applied, breaking legacy fallback.
findings.fix: resolve_priority returns exact legacy plus recorded uncertainty.

findings.summary: validate_pdf_output compared headlines against pypdf text that inserts kerning gaps ('lesbar , aber', 'browser- tab'); any reordered lever with such text failed.
findings.fix: Normalize whitespace before punctuation and after hyphens on both sides.
findings.probe: run_vc03_customer_release_evals cases B/C; foreign-headline canary still FAIL

findings.summary: VC03 observation copy (120 chars) was truncated in the 110-char category summary.
findings.fix: All VC03 observations <= 110 chars; test asserts it.

findings.summary: Page 9 card 3 bottom line overlaps the page footer; identical in the legacy baseline PDF.
findings.fix: None in this patch (presentation template is protected; no layout redesign in scope).
findings.probe: rendered page-009.png legacy vs case C

batch_csv: Attaching VC03 changes only digest-derived columns audit_id and website_analysis_report; pinned by test_batch_csv_only_digest_columns_change.
